name: fundchain
description: FundChain — platform fundraising mahasiswa BINUS dengan blockchain proof layer

scripts.bootstrap: pnpm --filter @fundchain/shared build && pnpm --filter @fundchain/api db:generate && pnpm --filter @fundchain/api db:setup
scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @fundchain/shared build && concurrently -n chain,deploy,api,web -c yellow,magenta,cyan,green "pnpm --filter @fundchain/contracts node" "pnpm --filter @fundchain/contracts deploy:local:wait" "pnpm --filter @fundchain/api dev" "pnpm --filter @fundchain/web dev"
scripts.dev:web:remote: pnpm --filter @fundchain/shared build && pnpm --filter @fundchain/web exec vite --mode remote
scripts.bc-local:db:check: docker compose -f compose.bc-local.yml exec -T postgres pg_isready -U fundchain -d fundchain_bc_dev
scripts.bc-local:db:migrations:check: pnpm dlx node@20 scripts/bc-local.cjs prisma migrate status
scripts.bc-local:db:migrate: pnpm dlx node@20 scripts/bc-local.cjs prisma migrate deploy
scripts.bc-local:db:seed: pnpm dlx node@20 scripts/bc-local.cjs prisma db seed
scripts.bc-local:db:setup: pnpm bc-local:db:start && pnpm bc-local:db:migrate && pnpm bc-local:db:seed
scripts.bc-local:chain: pnpm dlx node@20 scripts/bc-local.cjs hardhat node
scripts.bc-local:contract:deploy: pnpm dlx node@20 scripts/bc-local.cjs hardhat run scripts/deploy.ts --network localhost
scripts.bc-local:contract:deploy:wait: pnpm --filter @fundchain/contracts exec wait-on -t 120000 tcp:127.0.0.1:8545 && pnpm bc-local:contract:deploy
scripts.bc-local:dev: pnpm bc-local:db:start && pnpm --filter @fundchain/shared build && concurrently -n chain,deploy,api,web -c yellow,magenta,cyan,green "pnpm bc-local:chain" "pnpm bc-local:contract:deploy:wait" "pnpm bc-local:api" "pnpm bc-local:web"
scripts.bc-local:dev:worker: pnpm bc-local:db:start && pnpm --filter @fundchain/shared build && concurrently -n chain,deploy,api,web -c yellow,magenta,cyan,green "pnpm bc-local:chain" "pnpm bc-local:contract:deploy:wait" "pnpm bc-local:api:worker" "pnpm bc-local:web"
